evals.name: bulk-bands-and-no-match
evals.prompt: Use the root node of the Atlas Grid GTM context. Score these already-segmented accounts from supplied facts only: (1) Riverbend Electric Cooperative, label regional-utilities, an electric cooperative with 640 employees modernizing grid operations whose buying team owns outage response and field dispatch; (2) Gridwise Municipal Power, label regional-utilities, a 900-person electric utility modernizing grid operations, with no buying-team details supplied; (3) Sunbeam Solar, label no-match, a 45-person residential solar installer. Do not assign or change labels and do not enrich.
evals.expected_output: A bulk strong-fit, good-fit, and no-fit result with a reconciled band distribution and unchanged supplied labels.
expectations: States the Atlas Grid context line with one visible ICP.
Preserves all supplied labels exactly and never re-segments.
Assigns Riverbend strong-fit, Gridwise good-fit, and Sunbeam no-fit exactly once each.
Opens with accurate label counts, band distribution, low-confidence count, and review-needed count.
Grounds bands in ICP prose without arithmetic or a point rubric.
Uses every compact scoring field, asks no question, and closes with the exact no-side-effects sentence.
Leaves the context repo and Git history unchanged.

evals.name: suborg-disqualifier-cap
evals.prompt: Use the Enterprise node in the Northstar Cloud GTM context. Score Meridian Bank with supplied label enterprise/regulated-financial-platforms. Supplied facts: regulated bank; 8,200 employees; dedicated cloud platform team; mandatory third-party security review; corporate policy prohibits every third-party cloud service. Use supplied facts only, do not change the label, and do not enrich.
evals.expected_output: A weak-fit result capped by the Enterprise ICP's quoted disqualifier, using no root ICP content.
expectations: States the Northstar Enterprise context line with one visible ICP.
Validates and preserves enterprise/regulated-financial-platforms.
Assigns exactly weak-fit and explicitly says the disqualifier caps the band.
Quotes the ICP's own prohibition language while still naming matched fit signals.
Never reads or mentions root-only ICP content.
Uses the compact scoring fields, asks no question, and closes with the exact no-side-effects sentence.
Leaves all durable state unchanged.
